preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The input string s must be non-empty.
The input string s must contain only digit characters.

postconditions.description: The return value equals the total count of all valid ways to decode the string s into letters A-Z, where a valid way is a sequence of 1 or 2 digit numbers (1-26) that concatenate to form s without leading zeros in any number.
The return value is a non-negative integer.
